articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: CME Group Record Results Highlight Growing Volumes And New Derivatives Tools. CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) reported record quarterly results, with first quarter revenue and net income reaching all time highs. Performance was supported by a 22% jump in average daily volume across all asset classes and higher participation from non U.S. clients. The company broadened its derivatives offering with new options on Eris SOFR Swap futures and updates to its Equity Index Dividend products.
